Ket qua 100a/100b (tn161/156): bao so engine vs tester cho cloud. (3) 17H/17M: cloud xep 18-do-sau-AUDCAD-H1/M30/M15 (so bar moi nam) - chua tin 17H/17M truoc khi co.
